v14SyncPolicy.description: Specifies the properties of a policy.

accelerated_failback.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will perform failback configuration tasks during the next job run, rather than waiting to perform those tasks during the failback process. Performing these tasks ahead of time will increase the speed of failback operations.

action.description: If 'copy', source files will be copied to the target cluster.  If 'sync', the target directory will be made an image of the source directory:  Files and directories that have been deleted on the source, have been moved within the target directory, or no longer match the selection criteria will be deleted from the target directory.

allow_copy_fb.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will allow a policy with copy action failback which is not supported by default.

bandwidth_reservation.description: The desired bandwidth reservation for this policy in kb/s. This feature will not activate unless a SyncIQ bandwidth rule is in effect.

changelist.description: If true, retain previous source snapshot and incremental repstate, both of which are required for changelist creation.

check_integrity.description: If true, the sync target performs cyclic redundancy checks (CRC) on the data as it is received.

cloud_deep_copy.description: If set to deny, replicates all CloudPools smartlinks to the target cluster as smartlinks; if the target cluster does not support the smartlinks, the job will fail. If set to force, replicates all smartlinks to the target cluster as regular files. If set to allow, SyncIQ will attempt to replicate smartlinks to the target cluster as smartlinks; if the target cluster does not support the smartlinks, SyncIQ will replicate the smartlinks as regular files.

delete_quotas.description: If true, forcibly remove quotas on the target after they have been removed on the source.

description.description: User-assigned description of this sync policy.

disable_file_split.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the 7.2+ file splitting capability will be disabled.

disable_fofb.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable sync failover/failback.

disable_quota_tmp_dir.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not create temporary quota directories to aid in replication to target paths which contain quotas.

disable_stf.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable the 6.5+ STF based data transfer and uses only treewalk.

enable_hash_tmpdir.description: If true, syncs will use temporary working directory subdirectories to reduce lock contention.

enabled.description: If true, jobs will be automatically run based on this policy, according to its schedule.

encryption_cipher_list.description: The cipher list being used with encryption. For SyncIQ targets, this list serves as a list of supported ciphers. For SyncIQ sources, the list of ciphers will be attempted to be used in order.

expected_dataloss.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Continue sending files even with the corrupted filesystem.

force_interface.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Determines whether data is sent only through the subnet and pool specified in the "source_network" field. This option can be useful if there are multiple interfaces for the given source subnet.  If you enable this option, the net.inet.ip.choose_ifa_by_ipsrc sysctl should be set.

ignore_recursive_quota.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not check the recursive quota in target paths to aid in replication to target paths which contain no quota but target cluster has lots of quotas.

job_delay.description: If --schedule is set to When-Source-Modified, the duration to wait after a modification is made before starting a job (default is 0 seconds).

linked_service_policies.description: A list of service replication policies that this data replication policy will be associated with.

log_level.description: Severity an event must reach before it is logged.

log_removed_files.description: If true, the system will log any files or directories that are deleted due to a sync.

name.description: User-assigned name of this sync policy.

ocsp_address.description: The address of the OCSP responder to which to connect.

ocsp_issuer_certificate_id.description: The ID of the certificate authority that issued the certificate whose revocation status is being checked.

password.description: The password for the target cluster.  This field is not readable.

priority.description: Determines the priority level of a policy. Policies with higher priority will have precedence to run over lower priority policies. Valid range is [0, 1]. Default is 0.

report_max_age.description: Length of time (in seconds) a policy report will be stored.

report_max_count.description: Maximum number of policy reports that will be stored on the system.

restrict_target_network.description: If you specify true, and you specify a SmartConnect zone in the "target_host" field, replication policies will connect only to nodes in the specified SmartConnect zone.  If you specify false, replication policies are not restricted to specific nodes on the target cluster.

rpo_alert.description: If --schedule is set to a time/date, an alert is created if the specified RPO for this policy is exceeded. The default value is 0, which will not generate RPO alerts.

schedule.description: The schedule on which new jobs will be run for this policy.

service_policy.description: If true, this is a service replication policy.

skip_lookup.description: Skip DNS lookup of target IPs.

skip_when_source_unmodified.description: If true and --schedule is set to a time/date, the policy will not run if no changes have been made to the contents of the source directory since the last job successfully completed.

snapshot_sync_existing.description: If true, snapshot-triggered syncs will include snapshots taken before policy creation time (requires --schedule when-snapshot-taken).

snapshot_sync_pattern.description: The naming pattern that a snapshot must match to trigger a sync when the schedule is when-snapshot-taken (default is "*").

v18SyncPolicy.description: Specifies the properties of a policy.

accelerated_failback.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will perform failback configuration tasks during the next job run, rather than waiting to perform those tasks during the failback process. Performing these tasks ahead of time will increase the speed of failback operations.

action.description: If 'copy', source files will be copied to the target cluster.  If 'sync', the target directory will be made an image of the source directory:  Files and directories that have been deleted on the source, have been moved within the target directory, or no longer match the selection criteria will be deleted from the target directory.

allow_copy_fb.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will allow a policy with copy action failback which is not supported by default.

bandwidth_reservation.description: The desired bandwidth reservation for this policy in kb/s. This feature will not activate unless a SyncIQ bandwidth rule is in effect.

changelist.description: If true, retain previous source snapshot and incremental repstate, both of which are required for changelist creation.

check_integrity.description: If true, the sync target performs cyclic redundancy checks (CRC) on the data as it is received.

cloud_deep_copy.description: If set to deny, replicates all CloudPools smartlinks to the target cluster as smartlinks; if the target cluster does not support the smartlinks, the job will fail. If set to force, replicates all smartlinks to the target cluster as regular files. If set to allow, SyncIQ will attempt to replicate smartlinks to the target cluster as smartlinks; if the target cluster does not support the smartlinks, SyncIQ will replicate the smartlinks as regular files.

delete_quotas.description: If true, forcibly remove quotas on the target after they have been removed on the source.

description.description: User-assigned description of this sync policy.

disable_file_split.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the 7.2+ file splitting capability will be disabled.

disable_fofb.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable sync failover/failback.

disable_quota_tmp_dir.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not create temporary quota directories to aid in replication to target paths which contain quotas.

disable_stf.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable the 6.5+ STF based data transfer and uses only treewalk.

elliptic_curve_list.description: The elliptic curve list being used with encryption. For SyncIQ targets, this list serves as a list of supported elliptic curves. For SyncIQ sources, the list of elliptic curves will be attempted to be used in order.

enable_hash_tmpdir.description: If true, syncs will use temporary working directory subdirectories to reduce lock contention.

enabled.description: If true, jobs will be automatically run based on this policy, according to its schedule.

encryption_cipher_list.description: The cipher list being used with encryption. For SyncIQ targets, this list serves as a list of supported ciphers. For SyncIQ sources, the list of ciphers will be attempted to be used in order.

expected_dataloss.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Continue sending files even with the corrupted filesystem.

force_interface.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Determines whether data is sent only through the subnet and pool specified in the "source_network" field. This option can be useful if there are multiple interfaces for the given source subnet.  If you enable this option, the net.inet.ip.choose_ifa_by_ipsrc sysctl should be set.

ignore_recursive_quota.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not check the recursive quota in target paths to aid in replication to target paths which contain no quota but target cluster has lots of quotas.

job_delay.description: If --schedule is set to When-Source-Modified, the duration to wait after a modification is made before starting a job (default is 0 seconds).

linked_service_policies.description: A list of service replication policies that this data replication policy will be associated with.

log_level.description: Severity an event must reach before it is logged.

log_removed_files.description: If true, the system will log any files or directories that are deleted due to a sync.

name.description: User-assigned name of this sync policy.

ocsp_address.description: The address of the OCSP responder to which to connect.

ocsp_issuer_certificate_id.description: The ID of the certificate authority that issued the certificate whose revocation status is being checked.

password.description: The password for the target cluster.  This field is not readable.

priority.description: Determines the priority level of a policy. Policies with higher priority will have precedence to run over lower priority policies. Valid range is [0, 1]. Default is 0.

report_max_age.description: Length of time (in seconds) a policy report will be stored.

report_max_count.description: Maximum number of policy reports that will be stored on the system.

restrict_target_network.description: If you specify true, and you specify a SmartConnect zone in the "target_host" field, replication policies will connect only to nodes in the specified SmartConnect zone.  If you specify false, replication policies are not restricted to specific nodes on the target cluster.

rpo_alert.description: If --schedule is set to a time/date, an alert is created if the specified RPO for this policy is exceeded. The default value is 0, which will not generate RPO alerts.

schedule.description: The schedule on which new jobs will be run for this policy.

service_policy.description: If true, this is a service replication policy.

skip_lookup.description: Skip DNS lookup of target IPs.

skip_when_source_unmodified.description: If true and --schedule is set to a time/date, the policy will not run if no changes have been made to the contents of the source directory since the last job successfully completed.

snapshot_sync_existing.description: If true, snapshot-triggered syncs will include snapshots taken before policy creation time (requires --schedule when-snapshot-taken).

snapshot_sync_pattern.description: The naming pattern that a snapshot must match to trigger a sync when the schedule is when-snapshot-taken (default is "*").

source_exclude_directories.description: Directories that will be excluded from the sync.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_include_directories.description: Directories that will be included in the sync.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_root_path.description: The root directory on the source cluster the files will be synced from.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_snapshot_archive.description: If true, archival snapshots of the source data will be taken on the source cluster before a sync.

source_snapshot_pattern.description: The name pattern for snapshots taken on the source cluster before a sync.

sync_existing_target_snapshot_pattern.description: The naming pattern for snapshot on the destination cluster when --sync-existing-snapshot is true

target_certificate_id.description: The ID of the target cluster certificate being used for encryption.

target_compare_initial_sync.description: If true, the target creates diffs against the original sync.

target_detect_modifications.description: If true, target cluster will detect if files have been changed on the target by legacy tree walk syncs.

target_path.description: Absolute filesystem path on the target cluster for the sync destination.

v18SyncPolicyExtendedExtended.description: Specifies the properties of a policy.

accelerated_failback.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will perform failback configuration tasks during the next job run, rather than waiting to perform those tasks during the failback process. Performing these tasks ahead of time will increase the speed of failback operations.

action.description: If 'copy', source files will be copied to the target cluster.  If 'sync', the target directory will be made an image of the source directory:  Files and directories that have been deleted on the source, have been moved within the target directory, or no longer match the selection criteria will be deleted from the target directory.

allow_copy_fb.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will allow a policy with copy action failback which is not supported by default.

bandwidth_reservation.description: The desired bandwidth reservation for this policy in kb/s. This feature will not activate unless a SyncIQ bandwidth rule is in effect.

changelist.description: If true, retain previous source snapshot and incremental repstate, both of which are required for changelist creation.

check_integrity.description: If true, the sync target performs cyclic redundancy checks (CRC) on the data as it is received.

cloud_deep_copy.description: If set to deny, replicates all CloudPools smartlinks to the target cluster as smartlinks; if the target cluster does not support the smartlinks, the job will fail. If set to force, replicates all smartlinks to the target cluster as regular files. If set to allow, SyncIQ will attempt to replicate smartlinks to the target cluster as smartlinks; if the target cluster does not support the smartlinks, SyncIQ will replicate the smartlinks as regular files.

conflicted.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the most recent run of this policy encountered an error and this policy will not start any more scheduled jobs until this field is manually set back to 'false'.

delete_quotas.description: If true, forcibly remove quotas on the target after they have been removed on the source.

description.description: User-assigned description of this sync policy.

disable_file_split.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the 7.2+ file splitting capability will be disabled.

disable_fofb.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable sync failover/failback.

disable_quota_tmp_dir.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not create temporary quota directories to aid in replication to target paths which contain quotas.

disable_stf.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable the 6.5+ STF based data transfer and uses only treewalk.

elliptic_curve_list.description: The elliptic curve list being used with encryption. For SyncIQ targets, this list serves as a list of supported elliptic curves. For SyncIQ sources, the list of elliptic curves will be attempted to be used in order.

enable_hash_tmpdir.description: If true, syncs will use temporary working directory subdirectories to reduce lock contention.

enabled.description: If true, jobs will be automatically run based on this policy, according to its schedule.

encryption_cipher_list.description: The cipher list being used with encryption. For SyncIQ targets, this list serves as a list of supported ciphers. For SyncIQ sources, the list of ciphers will be attempted to be used in order.

expected_dataloss.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Continue sending files even with the corrupted filesystem.

force_interface.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Determines whether data is sent only through the subnet and pool specified in the "source_network" field. This option can be useful if there are multiple interfaces for the given source subnet.  If you enable this option, the net.inet.ip.choose_ifa_by_ipsrc sysctl should be set.

ignore_recursive_quota.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not check the recursive quota in target paths to aid in replication to target paths which contain no quota but target cluster has lots of quotas.

job_delay.description: If --schedule is set to When-Source-Modified, the duration to wait after a modification is made before starting a job (default is 0 seconds).

linked_service_policies.description: A list of service replication policies that this data replication policy will be associated with.

v1SyncJobPolicy.description: The policy associated with this job, or null if there is currently no policy associated with this job (this can happen if the job is newly created and not yet fully populated in the underlying database).

action.description: The action to be taken by the job.

name.description: User-assigned name of this sync policy.

source_exclude_directories.description: Directories that will be excluded from the sync.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_include_directories.description: Directories that will be included in the sync.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_root_path.description: The root directory on the source cluster the files will be synced from.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

target_host.description: Hostname or IP address of sync target cluster.  Modifying the target cluster host can result in the policy being unrunnable if the new target does not match the current target association.

target_path.description: Absolute filesystem path on the target cluster for the sync destination.

v1SyncJobPolicyFileMatchingPattern.description: A file matching pattern, organized as an OR'ed set of AND'ed file criteria, for example ((a AND b) OR (x AND y)) used to define a set of files with specific properties.  Policies of type 'sync' cannot use 'path' or time criteria in their matching patterns, but policies of type 'copy' can use all listed criteria.

or_criteria.description: An array containing objects with "and_criteria" properties, each set of and_criteria will be logically OR'ed together to create the full file matching pattern.

and_criteria.description: An array containing individual file criterion objects each describing one criterion.  These are logically AND'ed together to form a set of criteria.

attribute_exists.description: For "custom_attribute" type criteria.  The file will match as long as the attribute named by "field" exists.  Default is true.

case_sensitive.description: If true, the value comparison will be case sensitive.  Default is true.

field.description: The name of the file attribute to match on (only required if this is a custom_attribute type criterion).  Default is an empty string "".

operator.description: How to compare the specified attribute of each file to the specified value.

type.description: The type of this criterion, that is, which file attribute to match on.

value.description: The value to compare the specified attribute of each file to.

whole_word.description: If true, the attribute must match the entire word.  Default is true.

connected.description: Whether there is a connection between the source and target.

last_split.description: The last time a network split occurred.

last_work.description: The last time the worker performed work.

process_id.description: The process ID of the worker.

source_host.description: The source host for this worker.

target_host.description: The target host for this worker.

resume.description: Provide this token as the 'resume' query argument to continue listing results.
Provide this token as the 'resume' query argument to continue listing results.

v1SyncPolicy.description: Specifies the properties of a policy.

action.description: If 'copy', source files will be copied to the target cluster.  If 'sync', the target directory will be made an image of the source directory:  Files and directories that have been deleted on the source, have been moved within the target directory, or no longer match the selection criteria will be deleted from the target directory.

changelist.description: If true, retain previous source snapshot and incremental repstate, both of which are required for changelist creation.

check_integrity.description: If true, the sync target performs cyclic redundancy checks (CRC) on the data as it is received.

description.description: User-assigned description of this sync policy.

disable_file_split.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the 7.2+ file splitting capability will be disabled.

disable_fofb.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable sync failover/failback.

disable_stf.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable the 6.5+ STF based data transfer and uses only treewalk.

enabled.description: If true, jobs will be automatically run based on this policy, according to its schedule.

expected_dataloss.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Continue sending files even with the corrupted filesystem.

force_interface.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Determines whether data is sent only through the subnet and pool specified in the "source_network" field. This option can be useful if there are multiple interfaces for the given source subnet.  If you enable this option, the net.inet.ip.choose_ifa_by_ipsrc sysctl should be set.

log_level.description: Severity an event must reach before it is logged.

log_removed_files.description: If true, the system will log any files or directories that are deleted due to a sync.

name.description: User-assigned name of this sync policy.

password.description: The password for the target cluster.  This field is not readable.

report_max_age.description: Length of time (in seconds) a policy report will be stored.

report_max_count.description: Maximum number of policy reports that will be stored on the system.

restrict_target_network.description: If you specify true, and you specify a SmartConnect zone in the "target_host" field, replication policies will connect only to nodes in the specified SmartConnect zone.  If you specify false, replication policies are not restricted to specific nodes on the target cluster.

schedule.description: The schedule on which new jobs will be run for this policy.

source_exclude_directories.description: Directories that will be excluded from the sync.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_include_directories.description: Directories that will be included in the sync.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_root_path.description: The root directory on the source cluster the files will be synced from.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_snapshot_archive.description: If true, archival snapshots of the source data will be taken on the source cluster before a sync.

source_snapshot_expiration.description: The length of time in seconds to keep snapshots on the source cluster.

source_snapshot_pattern.description: The name pattern for snapshots taken on the source cluster before a sync.

target_compare_initial_sync.description: If true, the target creates diffs against the original sync.

target_detect_modifications.description: If true, target cluster will detect if files have been changed on the target by legacy tree walk syncs.

target_host.description: Hostname or IP address of sync target cluster.  Modifying the target cluster host can result in the policy being unrunnable if the new target does not match the current target association.

target_path.description: Absolute filesystem path on the target cluster for the sync destination.

target_snapshot_alias.description: The alias of the snapshot taken on the target cluster after the sync completes. A value of @DEFAULT will reset this field to the default creation value.

target_snapshot_archive.description: If true, archival snapshots of the target data will be taken on the target cluster after successful sync completions.

target_snapshot_expiration.description: The length of time in seconds to keep snapshots on the target cluster.

target_snapshot_pattern.description: The name pattern for snapshots taken on the target cluster after the sync completes.  A value of @DEFAULT will reset this field to the default creation value.

workers_per_node.description: The number of worker threads on a node performing a sync.

autocommit_offset.description: Specifies the autocommit time period for the domain in seconds.  After a file is in the domain without being modified for the specified time period, the file is automatically committed. If this parameter is set to null, there is no autocommit time, and files must be committed manually.

default_retention.description: Specifies the default amount of time, in seconds, that a file in this domain will be protected for. The default retention period is applied if no retention date is manually set on the file. This parameter can also be set to 'forever', 'use_min' (which applies the 'min_retention' option), or 'use_max' (which applies the 'max_retention' option).

max_retention.description: Specifies the maximum amount of time, in seconds, that a file in this domain will be protected. This setting will override the retention period of any file committed with a longer retention period. If this parameter is set to null, an infinite length retention period is set.

min_retention.description: Specifies the minimum amount of time, in seconds, that a file in this domain will be protected. This setting will override the retention period of any file committed with a shorter retention period. If this parameter is set to null, this minimum value is not enforced. This parameter can also be set to 'forever'.

override_date.description: Specifies the override retention date for the domain. If this date is later than the retention date for any committed file, the file will remain protected until the override retention date.

The default retention period is applied if no retention date is manually set on the file. This parameter can also be set to 'forever', 'use_min' (which applies the 'min_retention' option), or 'use_max' (which applies the 'max_retention' option).

min_retention.description: Specifies the minimum amount of time, in seconds, that a file in this domain will be protected. v22NfsExport.description: Specifies configuration values for NFS exports.

all_dirs.description: True if all directories under the specified paths are mountable.

block_size.description: Specifies the block size returned by the NFS statfs procedure.

can_set_time.description: True if the client can set file times through the NFS set attribute request. This parameter does not affect server behavior, but is included to accommodate legacy client requirements.

case_insensitive.description: True if the case is ignored for file names. This parameter does not affect server behavior, but is included to accommodate legacy client requirements.

case_preserving.description: True if the case is preserved for file names. This parameter does not affect server behavior, but is included to accommodate legacy client requirements.

chown_restricted.description: True if the superuser can change file ownership. This parameter does not affect server behavior, but is included to accommodate legacy client requirements.

clients.description: Specifies the clients with root access to the export.

commit_asynchronous.description: True if NFS  commit  requests execute asynchronously.

create_path.description: Create path if does not exist.

description.description: Specifies the user-defined string that is used to identify the export.

directory_transfer_size.description: Specifies the preferred size for directory read operations.  This value is used to advise the client of optimal settings for the server.

encoding.description: Specifies the default character set encoding of the clients connecting to the export, unless otherwise specified.

link_max.description: Specifies the reported maximum number of links to a file. This parameter does not affect server behavior, but is included to accommodate legacy client requirements.

map_full.description: True if user mappings query the OneFS user database. When set to false, user mappings only query local authentication.

map_lookup_uid.description: True if incoming user IDs (UIDs) are mapped to users in the OneFS user database. When set to false, incoming UIDs are applied directly to file operations.

map_retry.description: Determines whether searches for users specified in 'map_all', 'map_root' or 'map_nonroot' are retried if the search fails.

max_file_size.description: Specifies the maximum file size for any file accessed from the export. This parameter does not affect server behavior, but is included to accommodate legacy client requirements.

name_max_size.description: Specifies the reported maximum length of a file name. This parameter does not affect server behavior, but is included to accommodate legacy client requirements.

no_truncate.description: True if long file names result in an error. This parameter does not affect server behavior, but is included to accommodate legacy client requirements.

paths.description: Specifies the paths under /ifs that are exported.

read_only.description: True if the export is set to read-only.

read_only_clients.description: Specifies the clients with read-only access to the export.

read_transfer_max_size.description: Specifies the maximum buffer size that clients should use on NFS read requests. This value is used to advise the client of optimal settings for the server.

read_transfer_multiple.description: Specifies the preferred multiple size for NFS read requests. This value is used to advise the client of optimal settings for the server, but is not enforced.

read_transfer_size.description: Specifies the preferred size for NFS read requests. This value is used to advise the client of optimal settings for the server.

read_write_clients.description: Specifies the clients with both read and write access to the export, even when the export is set to read-only.

readdirplus.description: True if 'readdirplus' requests are enabled. Enabling this property might improve network performance and is only available for NFSv3.

readdirplus_prefetch.description: Sets the number of directory entries that are prefetched when a 'readdirplus' request is processed. (Deprecated.)

return_32bit_file_ids.description: Limits the size of file identifiers returned by NFSv3+ to 32-bit values (may require remount).

root_clients.description: Clients that have root access to the export.

security_flavors.description: Specifies the authentication types that are supported for this export.

items.description: Specifies the authentication types that are supported for this export.

setattr_asynchronous.description: True if set attribute operations execute asynchronously.

snapshot.description: Specifies the snapshot for all mounts.

symlinks.description: True if symlinks are supported. This value is used to advise the client of optimal settings for the server, but is not enforced.

time_delta.description: Specifies the resolution of all time values that are returned to the clients

write_datasync_action.description: Specifies the action to be taken when an NFSv3+ datasync write is requested.

write_datasync_reply.description: Specifies the stability disposition returned when an NFSv3+ datasync write is processed.

If this threshold is reached, sshd will disconnect the client, terminating the session. Setting this to zero disables connection termination.

host_key_algorithms.description: Specifies the protocol version 2 host key algorithms the server offers.

keyboard_interactive_authentication.description: Specifies whether to allow keyboard-interactive authentication.

log_level.description: Specifies the log level when logging messages from sshd(8).

login_grace_time.description: Specifies the length of time in seconds before idle log in fails.  If the value is 0, there is no time limit.

max_auth_tries.description: Specifies the maximum number of authentication attempts per connection.

max_sessions.description: Specifies the maximum number of open sessions permitted per network connection.

max_startups.description: Specifies maximum number of unauthenticated connections.

password_authentication.description: Specifies whether password authentication is allowed.

permit_empty_passwords.description: Enable empty passwords if password authentication is allowed.

port.description: Specifies the port sshd(8) should listen on

print_motd.description: Enable printing /etc/motd when a user logs in.

bandwidth_reservation_reserve_percentage.description: The percentage of SyncIQ bandwidth to reserve for policies that did not specify a bandwidth reservation.

cluster_certificate_id.description: The ID of this cluster's certificate being used for encryption.

elliptic_curve_list.description: The elliptic curve list being used with encryption. For SyncIQ targets, this list serves as a list of supported elliptic curves. For SyncIQ sources, the list of elliptic curves will be attempted to be used in order.

encryption_cipher_list.description: The cipher list being used with encryption. For SyncIQ targets, this list serves as a list of supported ciphers. For SyncIQ sources, the list of ciphers will be attempted to be used in order.

encryption_required.description: If true, requires all SyncIQ policies to utilize encrypted communications.

force_interface.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Default for the "force_interface" property that will be applied to each new sync policy unless otherwise specified at the time of policy creation.  Determines whether data is sent only through the subnet and pool specified in the "source_network" field. This option can be useful if there are multiple interfaces for the given source subnet.

ocsp_address.description: The address of the OCSP responder to which to connect.

ocsp_issuer_certificate_id.description: The ID of the certificate authority that issued the certificate whose revocation status is being checked.

password.description: The password for cluster authentication

preferred_rpo_alert.description: If specified, display as default RPO Alert value for new policy creation via WebUI

renegotiation_bytes.description: Default for the number of bytes that are passed before a new TLS connection is 1TB. Setting to 0 will disable renegotiations based on bytes.

renegotiation_period.description: If specified, the duration to persist encrypted connection before forcing a renegotiation.

report_email.description: Email sync reports to these addresses.

report_max_age.description: The default length of time (in seconds) a policy report will be stored.

report_max_count.description: The default maximum number of reports to retain for a policy.

restrict_target_network.description: Default for the "restrict_target_network" property that will be applied to each new sync policy unless otherwise specified at the time of policy creation.  If you specify true, and you specify a SmartConnect zone in the "target_host" field, replication policies will connect only to nodes in the specified SmartConnect zone.  If you specify false, replication policies are not restricted to specific nodes on the target cluster.

rpo_alerts.description: If disabled, no RPO alerts will be generated.

service.description: Specifies if the SyncIQ service currently on, paused, or off.  If paused, all sync jobs will be paused.  If turned off, all jobs will be canceled.

service_history_max_age.description: Maximum age of service information to maintain, in seconds.

service_history_max_count.description: Maximum number of historical service information records to maintain.

tw_chkpt_interval.description: The interval (in seconds) in which treewalk syncs are forced to checkpoint.

use_workers_per_node.description: If enabled, SyncIQ will use the deprecated workers_per_node field with worker pools functionality and limit workers accordingly.

v3SyncPolicy.description: Specifies the properties of a policy.

accelerated_failback.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will perform failback configuration tasks during the next job run, rather than waiting to perform those tasks during the failback process. Performing these tasks ahead of time will increase the speed of failback operations.

action.description: If 'copy', source files will be copied to the target cluster.  If 'sync', the target directory will be made an image of the source directory:  Files and directories that have been deleted on the source, have been moved within the target directory, or no longer match the selection criteria will be deleted from the target directory.

changelist.description: If true, retain previous source snapshot and incremental repstate, both of which are required for changelist creation.

check_integrity.description: If true, the sync target performs cyclic redundancy checks (CRC) on the data as it is received.

cloud_deep_copy.description: If set to deny, replicates all CloudPools smartlinks to the target cluster as smartlinks; if the target cluster does not support the smartlinks, the job will fail. If set to force, replicates all smartlinks to the target cluster as regular files. If set to allow, SyncIQ will attempt to replicate smartlinks to the target cluster as smartlinks; if the target cluster does not support the smartlinks, SyncIQ will replicate the smartlinks as regular files.

description.description: User-assigned description of this sync policy.

disable_file_split.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the 7.2+ file splitting capability will be disabled.

disable_fofb.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable sync failover/failback.

disable_quota_tmp_dir.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not create temporary quota directories to aid in replication to target paths which contain quotas.

disable_stf.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable the 6.5+ STF based data transfer and uses only treewalk.

enabled.description: If true, jobs will be automatically run based on this policy, according to its schedule.

expected_dataloss.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Continue sending files even with the corrupted filesystem.

force_interface.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Determines whether data is sent only through the subnet and pool specified in the "source_network" field. This option can be useful if there are multiple interfaces for the given source subnet.  If you enable this option, the net.inet.ip.choose_ifa_by_ipsrc sysctl should be set.

job_delay.description: If --schedule is set to When-Source-Modified, the duration to wait after a modification is made before starting a job (default is 0 seconds).

log_level.description: Severity an event must reach before it is logged.

log_removed_files.description: If true, the system will log any files or directories that are deleted due to a sync.

name.description: User-assigned name of this sync policy.

password.description: The password for the target cluster.  This field is not readable.

priority.description: Determines the priority level of a policy. Policies with higher priority will have precedence to run over lower priority policies. Valid range is [0, 1]. Default is 0.

report_max_age.description: Length of time (in seconds) a policy report will be stored.

report_max_count.description: Maximum number of policy reports that will be stored on the system.

restrict_target_network.description: If you specify true, and you specify a SmartConnect zone in the "target_host" field, replication policies will connect only to nodes in the specified SmartConnect zone.  If you specify false, replication policies are not restricted to specific nodes on the target cluster.

rpo_alert.description: If --schedule is set to a time/date, an alert is created if the specified RPO for this policy is exceeded. The default value is 0, which will not generate RPO alerts.

schedule.description: The schedule on which new jobs will be run for this policy.

skip_lookup.description: Skip DNS lookup of target IPs.

skip_when_source_unmodified.description: If true and --schedule is set to a time/date, the policy will not run if no changes have been made to the contents of the source directory since the last job successfully completed.

snapshot_sync_existing.description: If true, snapshot-triggered syncs will include snapshots taken before policy creation time (requires --schedule when-snapshot-taken).

snapshot_sync_pattern.description: The naming pattern that a snapshot must match to trigger a sync when the schedule is when-snapshot-taken (default is "*").

source_exclude_directories.description: Directories that will be excluded from the sync.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_include_directories.description: Directories that will be included in the sync.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_root_path.description: The root directory on the source cluster the files will be synced from.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_snapshot_archive.description: If true, archival snapshots of the source data will be taken on the source cluster before a sync.

source_snapshot_expiration.description: The length of time in seconds to keep snapshots on the source cluster.

source_snapshot_pattern.description: The name pattern for snapshots taken on the source cluster before a sync.

target_compare_initial_sync.description: If true, the target creates diffs against the original sync.

target_detect_modifications.description: If true, target cluster will detect if files have been changed on the target by legacy tree walk syncs.

target_host.description: Hostname or IP address of sync target cluster.  Modifying the target cluster host can result in the policy being unrunnable if the new target does not match the current target association.

target_path.description: Absolute filesystem path on the target cluster for the sync destination.

target_snapshot_alias.description: The alias of the snapshot taken on the target cluster after the sync completes. A value of @DEFAULT will reset this field to the default creation value.

target_snapshot_archive.description: If true, archival snapshots of the target data will be taken on the target cluster after successful sync completions.

target_snapshot_expiration.description: The length of time in seconds to keep snapshots on the target cluster.

target_snapshot_pattern.description: The name pattern for snapshots taken on the target cluster after the sync completes.  A value of @DEFAULT will reset this field to the default creation value.

workers_per_node.description: The number of worker threads on a node performing a sync.

accelerated_failback.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will perform failback configuration tasks during the next job run, rather than waiting to perform those tasks during the failback process. Performing these tasks ahead of time will increase the speed of failback operations.

action.description: If 'copy', source files will be copied to the target cluster.  If 'sync', the target directory will be made an image of the source directory:  Files and directories that have been deleted on the source, have been moved within the target directory, or no longer match the selection criteria will be deleted from the target directory.

changelist.description: If true, retain previous source snapshot and incremental repstate, both of which are required for changelist creation.

check_integrity.description: If true, the sync target performs cyclic redundancy checks (CRC) on the data as it is received.

cloud_deep_copy.description: If set to deny, replicates all CloudPools smartlinks to the target cluster as smartlinks; if the target cluster does not support the smartlinks, the job will fail. If set to force, replicates all smartlinks to the target cluster as regular files. If set to allow, SyncIQ will attempt to replicate smartlinks to the target cluster as smartlinks; if the target cluster does not support the smartlinks, SyncIQ will replicate the smartlinks as regular files.

conflicted.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the most recent run of this policy encountered an error and this policy will not start any more scheduled jobs until this field is manually set back to 'false'.

description.description: User-assigned description of this sync policy.

disable_file_split.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the 7.2+ file splitting capability will be disabled.

disable_fofb.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable sync failover/failback.

disable_quota_tmp_dir.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not create temporary quota directories to aid in replication to target paths which contain quotas.

disable_stf.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable the 6.5+ STF based data transfer and uses only treewalk.

enabled.description: If true, jobs will be automatically run based on this policy, according to its schedule.

expected_dataloss.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Continue sending files even with the corrupted filesystem.

force_interface.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support. If you enable this option, the net.inet.ip.choose_ifa_by_ipsrc sysctl should be set.

has_sync_state.description: This field is false if the policy is in its initial sync state and true otherwise.  Setting this field to false will reset the policy's sync state.

id.description: The system ID given to this sync policy.

last_success.description: Timestamp of last known successfully completed synchronization.  Value is null if the policy has never completed successfully.

log_level.description: Severity an event must reach before it is logged.

log_removed_files.description: If true, the system will log any files or directories that are deleted due to a sync.

name.description: User-assigned name of this sync policy.

next_run.description: This is the next time a job is scheduled to run for this policy in Unix epoch seconds.  This field is null if the job is not scheduled.

password_set.description: Indicates if a password is set for accessing the target cluster. Password value is not shown with GET.

priority.description: Determines the priority level of a policy. Policies with higher priority will have precedence to run over lower priority policies. Valid range is [0, 1]. Default is 0.

report_max_age.description: Length of time (in seconds) a policy report will be stored.

report_max_count.description: Maximum number of policy reports that will be stored on the system.

restrict_target_network.description: If you specify true, and you specify a SmartConnect zone in the "target_host" field, replication policies will connect only to nodes in the specified SmartConnect zone. rpo_alert.description: If --schedule is set to a time/date, an alert is created if the specified RPO for this policy is exceeded. The default value is 0, which will not generate RPO alerts.

schedule.description: The schedule on which new jobs will be run for this policy.

skip_lookup.description: Skip DNS lookup of target IPs.

skip_when_source_unmodified.description: If true and --schedule is set to a time/date, the policy will not run if no changes have been made to the contents of the source directory since the last job successfully completed.

source_include_directories.description: Directories that will be included in the sync.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_root_path.description: The root directory on the source cluster the files will be synced from.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_snapshot_pattern.description: The name pattern for snapshots taken on the source cluster before a sync.

target_compare_initial_sync.description: If true, the target creates diffs against the original sync.

duration.description: The amount of time in seconds between when the job was started and when it ended.  If the job has not yet ended, this is the amount of time since the job started.  This field is null if the job has not yet started.

encrypted.description: If true, syncs will be encrypted.

end_time.description: The time the job ended in unix epoch seconds. The field is null if the job hasn't ended.

error.description: The primary error message for this job.

error_checksum_files_skipped.description: The number of files with checksum errors skipped by this job.

error_io_files_skipped.description: The number of files with io errors skipped by this job.

error_net_files_skipped.description: The number of files with network errors skipped by this job.

errors.description: A list of error messages for this job.

failed_chunks.description: Tyhe number of data chunks that failed transmission.

fifos_replicated.description: The number of fifos replicated by this job.

file_data_bytes.description: The number of bytes transferred that belong to files.

files_changed.description: The number of files changed by this job.

files_linked.description: The number of files linked by this job.

files_new.description: The number of files created by this job.

files_selected.description: The number of files selected by this job.

files_transferred.description: The number of files transferred by this job.

files_unlinked.description: The number of files unlinked by this job.

files_with_ads_replicated.description: The number of files with ads replicated by this job.

flipped_lins.description: The number of LINs flipped by this job.

hard_links_replicated.description: The number of hard links replicated by this job.

hash_exceptions_fixed.description: The number of hash exceptions fixed by this job.

hash_exceptions_found.description: The number of hash exceptions found by this job.

id.description: A unique identifier for this object.

lins_total.description: The number of LINs transferred by this job.

network_bytes_to_source.description: The total number of bytes sent to the source by this job.

network_bytes_to_target.description: The total number of bytes sent to the target by this job.

new_files_replicated.description: The number of new files replicated by this job.

num_retransmitted_files.description: The number of files that have been retransmitted by this job.

phases.description: Data for each phase of this job.

quotas_deleted.description: The number of quotas removed from the target.

regular_files_replicated.description: The number of regular files replicated by this job.

resynced_lins.description: The number of LINs resynched by this job.

retransmitted_files.description: The files that have been retransmitted by this job.

retry.description: The number of times the job has been retried.

running_chunks.description: The number of data chunks currently being transmitted.

service_report.description: Data for each component exported as part of service replication.

sockets_replicated.description: The number of sockets replicated by this job.

source_bytes_recovered.description: The number of bytes recovered on the source.

source_directories_created.description: The number of directories created on the source.

source_directories_deleted.description: The number of directories deleted on the source.

source_directories_linked.description: The number of directories linked on the source.

source_directories_unlinked.description: The number of directories unlinked on the source.

source_directories_visited.description: The number of directories visited on the source.

source_files_deleted.description: The number of files deleted on the source.

source_files_linked.description: The number of files linked on the source.

source_files_unlinked.description: The number of files unlinked on the source.

source_host.description: Hostname or IP address of sync source cluster.

sparse_data_bytes.description: The number of sparse data bytes transferred by this job.

start_time.description: The time the job started in unix epoch seconds. The field is null if the job hasn't started.

succeeded_chunks.description: The number of data chunks that have been transmitted successfully.

symlinks_replicated.description: The number of symlinks replicated by this job.

sync_type.description: The type of sync being performed by this job.

target_bytes_recovered.description: The number of bytes recovered on the target.

target_directories_created.description: The number of directories created on the target.

target_directories_deleted.description: The number of directories deleted on the target.

target_directories_linked.description: The number of directories linked on the target.

target_directories_unlinked.description: The number of directories unlinked on the target.

target_files_deleted.description: The number of files deleted on the target.

target_files_linked.description: The number of files linked on the target.

target_files_unlinked.description: The number of files unlinked on the target.

target_path.description: Absolute filesystem path on the target cluster for the sync destination.

target_snapshots.description: The target snapshots created by this job.

total_chunks.description: The total number of data chunks transmitted by this job.

total_data_bytes.description: The total number of bytes transferred by this job.

total_exported_services.description: The total number of components exported as part of service replication.

total_files.description: The number of files affected by this job.

total_network_bytes.description: The total number of bytes sent over the network by this job.

total_phases.description: The total number of phases for this job.

unchanged_data_bytes.description: The number of bytes unchanged by this job.

up_to_date_files_skipped.description: The number of up-to-date files skipped by this job.

updated_files_replicated.description: The number of updated files replicated by this job.

user_conflict_files_skipped.description: The number of files with user conflicts skipped by this job.

warnings.description: A list of warning messages for this job.

worm_committed_file_conflicts.description: The number of WORM committed files which needed to be reverted. Since WORM committed files cannot be reverted, this is the number of files that were preserved in the compliance store.

resume.description: Provide this token as the 'resume' query argument to continue listing results.

v7ServicePolicy.description: Specifies the properties of a policy.

accelerated_failback.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will perform failback configuration tasks during the next job run, rather than waiting to perform those tasks during the failback process. Performing these tasks ahead of time will increase the speed of failback operations.

allow_copy_fb.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will allow a policy with copy action failback which is not supported by default.

bandwidth_reservation.description: The desired bandwidth reservation for this policy in kb/s. This feature will not activate unless a SyncIQ bandwidth rule is in effect.

check_integrity.description: If true, the sync target performs cyclic redundancy checks (CRC) on the data as it is received.

description.description: User-assigned description of this sync policy.

disable_file_split.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the 7.2+ file splitting capability will be disabled.

disable_fofb.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable sync failover/failback.

disable_quota_tmp_dir.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not create temporary quota directories to aid in replication to target paths which contain quotas.

enabled.description: If true, jobs will be automatically run based on this policy, according to its schedule.

encryption_cipher_list.description: The cipher list being used with encryption. For SyncIQ targets, this list serves as a list of supported ciphers. For SyncIQ sources, the list of ciphers will be attempted to be used in order.

expected_dataloss.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Continue sending files even with the corrupted filesystem.

force_interface.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Determines whether data is sent only through the subnet and pool specified in the "source_network" field. This option can be useful if there are multiple interfaces for the given source subnet.  If you enable this option, the net.inet.ip.choose_ifa_by_ipsrc sysctl should be set.

ignore_recursive_quota.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not check the recursive quota in target paths to aid in replication to target paths which contain no quota but target cluster has lots of quotas.

linked_data_policies.description: A list of SyncIQ policy names/IDs whose source root directories will be used to filter service replication.

log_level.description: Severity an event must reach before it is logged.

name.description: User-assigned name of this sync policy.

ocsp_address.description: The address of the OCSP responder to which to connect.

ocsp_issuer_certificate_id.description: The ID of the certificate authority that issued the certificate whose revocation status is being checked.

password.description: The password for the target cluster.  This field is not readable.

priority.description: Determines the priority level of a policy. Policies with higher priority will have precedence to run over lower priority policies. Valid range is [0, 1]. Default is 0.

replicated_services.description: A list of services to replicate.

report_max_age.description: Length of time (in seconds) a policy report will be stored.

report_max_count.description: Maximum number of policy reports that will be stored on the system.

restrict_target_network.description: If you specify true, and you specify a SmartConnect zone in the "target_host" field, replication policies will connect only to nodes in the specified SmartConnect zone.  If you specify false, replication policies are not restricted to specific nodes on the target cluster.

rpo_alert.description: If --schedule is set to a time/date, an alert is created if the specified RPO for this policy is exceeded. The default value is 0, which will not generate RPO alerts.

schedule.description: The schedule on which new jobs will be run for this policy.

service_history_max_age.description: Maximum age of service information to maintain, in seconds.

service_history_max_count.description: Maximum number of historical service information records to maintain.

skip_lookup.description: Skip DNS lookup of target IPs.

snapshot_sync_existing.description: If true, snapshot-triggered syncs will include snapshots taken before policy creation time (requires --schedule when-snapshot-taken).

snapshot_sync_pattern.description: The naming pattern that a snapshot must match to trigger a sync when the schedule is when-snapshot-taken (default is "*").

source_snapshot_expiration.description: The length of time in seconds to keep snapshots on the source cluster.

source_snapshot_pattern.description: The name pattern for snapshots taken on the source cluster before a sync.

target_certificate_id.description: The ID of the target cluster certificate being used for encryption.

target_host.description: Hostname or IP address of sync target cluster.  Modifying the target cluster host can result in the policy being unrunnable if the new target does not match the current target association.

target_snapshot_alias.description: The alias of the snapshot taken on the target cluster after the sync completes. A value of @DEFAULT will reset this field to the default creation value.

target_snapshot_expiration.description: The length of time in seconds to keep snapshots on the target cluster.

target_snapshot_pattern.description: The name pattern for snapshots taken on the target cluster after the sync completes.  A value of @DEFAULT will reset this field to the default creation value.

workers_per_node.description: The number of worker threads on a node performing a sync.

accelerated_failback.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will perform failback configuration tasks during the next job run, rather than waiting to perform those tasks during the failback process. Performing these tasks ahead of time will increase the speed of failback operations.

action.description: If 'copy', source files will be copied to the target cluster.  If 'sync', the target directory will be made an image of the source directory:  Files and directories that have been deleted on the source, have been moved within the target directory, or no longer match the selection criteria will be deleted from the target directory.

allow_copy_fb.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will allow a policy with copy action failback which is not supported by default.

bandwidth_reservation.description: The desired bandwidth reservation for this policy in kb/s. This feature will not activate unless a SyncIQ bandwidth rule is in effect.

check_integrity.description: If true, the sync target performs cyclic redundancy checks (CRC) on the data as it is received.

conflicted.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the most recent run of this policy encountered an error and this policy will not start any more scheduled jobs until this field is manually set back to 'false'.

database_mirrored.description: If true, SyncIQ databases have been mirrored.

description.description: User-assigned description of this sync policy.

disable_file_split.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  If true, the 7.2+ file splitting capability will be disabled.

disable_fofb.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable sync failover/failback.

disable_quota_tmp_dir.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not create temporary quota directories to aid in replication to target paths which contain quotas.

disable_stf.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Enable/disable the 6.5+ STF based data transfer and uses only treewalk.

enabled.description: If true, jobs will be automatically run based on this policy, according to its schedule.

encrypted.description: If true, syncs will be encrypted.

encryption_cipher_list.description: The cipher list being used with encryption. For SyncIQ targets, this list serves as a list of supported ciphers. For SyncIQ sources, the list of ciphers will be attempted to be used in order.

expected_dataloss.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Continue sending files even with the corrupted filesystem.

force_interface.description: NOTE: This field should not be changed without the help of PowerScale support.  Determines whether data is sent only through the subnet and pool specified in the "source_network" field. This option can be useful if there are multiple interfaces for the given source subnet.  If you enable this option, the net.inet.ip.choose_ifa_by_ipsrc sysctl should be set.

has_sync_state.description: This field is false if the policy is in its initial sync state and true otherwise.  Setting this field to false will reset the policy's sync state.

id.description: The system ID given to this sync policy.

ignore_recursive_quota.description: If set to true, SyncIQ will not check the recursive quota in target paths to aid in replication to target paths which contain no quota but target cluster has lots of quotas.

last_job_state.description: This is the state of the most recent job for this policy.

last_started.description: The most recent time a job was started for this policy.  Value is null if the policy has never been run.

last_success.description: Timestamp of last known successfully completed synchronization.  Value is null if the policy has never completed successfully.

linked_data_policies.description: A list of SyncIQ policy names/IDs whose source root directories will be used to filter service replication.

log_level.description: Severity an event must reach before it is logged.

name.description: User-assigned name of this sync policy.

next_run.description: This is the next time a job is scheduled to run for this policy in Unix epoch seconds.  This field is null if the job is not scheduled.

ocsp_address.description: The address of the OCSP responder to which to connect.

ocsp_issuer_certificate_id.description: The ID of the certificate authority that issued the certificate whose revocation status is being checked.

priority.description: Determines the priority level of a policy. Policies with higher priority will have precedence to run over lower priority policies. Valid range is [0, 1]. Default is 0.

replicated_services.description: A list of services to replicate.

report_max_age.description: Length of time (in seconds) a policy report will be stored.

report_max_count.description: Maximum number of policy reports that will be stored on the system.

restrict_target_network.description: If you specify true, and you specify a SmartConnect zone in the "target_host" field, replication policies will connect only to nodes in the specified SmartConnect zone.  If you specify false, replication policies are not restricted to specific nodes on the target cluster.

rpo_alert.description: If --schedule is set to a time/date, an alert is created if the specified RPO for this policy is exceeded. The default value is 0, which will not generate RPO alerts.

schedule.description: The schedule on which new jobs will be run for this policy.

service_history_max_age.description: Maximum age of service information to maintain, in seconds.

service_history_max_count.description: Maximum number of historical service information records to maintain.

service_policy.description: If true, this is a service replication policy.

skip_lookup.description: Skip DNS lookup of target IPs.

snapshot_sync_existing.description: If true, snapshot-triggered syncs will include snapshots taken before policy creation time (requires --schedule when-snapshot-taken).

snapshot_sync_pattern.description: The naming pattern that a snapshot must match to trigger a sync when the schedule is when-snapshot-taken (default is "*").

source_certificate_id.description: The ID of the source cluster certificate being used for encryption.

source_domain_marked.description: If true, the source root path has been domain marked with a SyncIQ domain.

source_root_path.description: The root directory on the source cluster the files will be synced from.  Modifying this field will result in a full synchronization of all data.

source_snapshot_expiration.description: The length of time in seconds to keep snapshots on the source cluster.

source_snapshot_pattern.description: The name pattern for snapshots taken on the source cluster before a sync.

target_certificate_id.description: The ID of the target cluster certificate being used for encryption.

target_compare_initial_sync.description: If true, the target creates diffs against the original sync.

target_host.description: Hostname or IP address of sync target cluster.  Modifying the target cluster host can result in the policy being unrunnable if the new target does not match the current target association.

target_path.description: Absolute filesystem path on the target cluster for the sync destination.

target_snapshot_alias.description: The alias of the snapshot taken on the target cluster after the sync completes. A value of @DEFAULT will reset this field to the default creation value.

target_snapshot_pattern.description: The name pattern for snapshots taken on the target cluster after the sync completes.  A value of @DEFAULT will reset this field to the default creation value.

workers_per_node.description: The number of worker threads on a node performing a sync.
